title: Taiwanese Student Association at UC Berkeley
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at the University of California, Berkeley is a non-profit, non-political student organization dedicated to Taiwanese culture and community on campus. The organization maintains an official website at tsa.berkeley.edu, a CalLink directory listing, an Instagram account (@berkeleytsa) with over 1,900 followers, and a Facebook page under the name “UC Berkeley TSA 柏克萊加大台灣同學會.” Its Chinese name, 柏克萊加大台灣同學會, appears consistently across its social media presence.

TSA primarily serves Taiwanese students at Berkeley, offering a community for those who have recently arrived in the United States as well as any student with an interest in Taiwanese culture. The organization collaborates regularly with TASA at Berkeley and other Taiwanese student groups in the UC system. Note: The TSA website (tsa.berkeley.edu) is built as a single-page React application and did not yield crawlable mission or founding-year text at the time of research; no mission statement is reproduced here as a result.
